# text_board.py

[简体中文](text_board.zh.md) ｜ **English** ｜ [← Back to README](../../README.en.md)

Text: SVG text, textPath and text-to-path conversion.

This file contains a single class, `TextMixin`, a mixin that `board/__init__.py` composes into `MagicPen`.
